result.reason: Neither level is complete. The redline omits any stated services-warranty duration, does not cover all deliverables, and qualifies both software conformance and legal compliance by materiality. The 12-month software period, malicious-code warranty, professional-and-workmanlike standard, and repair/replacement/refund remedies are present. The additions do not negate unrelated commercial terms, but the incomplete duration and scope provisions prevent the redline from reaching even the fallback.
